info.name: Homebrew Feats
info.description: Feats from the Wardens of Faerûn.
info.author: Wizards of the Coast

description.p: Your strength and training allow you to use weapons that would be outsized for others. You gain the following benefits:

ul.li: Monkey Grip. You can wield one-handed weapons as if they were light, and you deal the higher damage die with versatile weapons even when wielding them one-handed as long as you don't have a weapon in your off-hand. You suffer no penalties for wielding heavy weapons.

Giant Blade. You have a custom "oversized" weapon built, which costs twice and weights four times as much as an ordinary weapon if its type. It gains the heavy and versatile traits. You deal an additional 1d4 damage when attacking with it one-handed and 1d6 damage when attacking two-handed. If it is a melee weapon, its reach increases by 5 feet while attacking on your turn, not for reaction attacks. If it is ranged or thrown its range increases by your strength modifier times 10 feet (minimum 5 feet up to double its normal range). Any other creature wields this weapon with disadvantage unless they have this feat.
